name: Nheko
description: Nheko's Windows App Installer manifest references the MSIX and requests on-launch update checks every 168 hours with a prompt; directly installed MSIX packages do not check. The AppImage recipe has no update-information value, so this review finds no AppImage self-updater. Windows signing is performed in CI with the configured certificate thumbprint.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; the source supports the documented platform split but not every historical release.
The classification is mixed across Windows installer channels and Linux AppImage, so no single primary tier is proposed.
